body:
Chief: BOTH HALVES OF THE DESIGN RESPONSE ARE RIGHT, and the privacy half is a real finding I have verified rather than accepted.

VERIFIED: PseudonymizedTranscript holds source: StorySource plus payload: PseudonymizedText - the certified object. RecallSegmenter.segment takes ONLY a StorySource. RecallGraph is (transcript: StorySource, atlas, units, relations) and CARRIES NO PRIVACY WITNESS AT ALL. So segmenting a pseudonymized transcript produces a RecallGraph from which the certification has simply evaporated; downstream, nothing can distinguish recall text that went through a certified detector from raw participant text. Same class as everything else tonight - a certified property lost across a transformation - arriving in the highest-stakes domain we have.

BUT I AM FILING IT P2, NOT P1, AND THE REASON IS TONIGHT'S OWN LESSON. I traced the consequence before rating it. NO CURRENT CONSUMER IS FOOLED, because no consumer currently reads recall text on the strength of an assumed certification - the renderer that would is the one this design bead is about, and it does not exist. Two hours ago I escalated an untraced consequence to P1 above all work and had to retract it; the correction I wrote into rule 4 says a claim about what a defect FEEDS is a claim about the call graph. Here the call graph says: real gap, no live victim. P2 hardening, to be closed BEFORE anything renders recall text, and I am recording that condition on the bead so it cannot be quietly deferred past the thing that makes it dangerous.

ON THE JOIN, ratified: the trace cannot key off a naked AlignRef.Cell. It carries only RecallUnitId plus AlignState, and both unit ids and SourceNodeRefs COLLIDE ACROSS INPUTS - so a valid-looking cell could display words from the wrong recall or the wrong source while every lookup succeeds. That is a silent wrong answer, which is worse than a failed lookup. The join must consume a match-checked bundle - HsmmResult plus the exact recall and view, verifying recallChecksum and viewFingerprint - or return a trace carrying those identities. And the scout is right that this is the SAME model-identity law already enforced in HsmmResult, AlignWire and PopulationAggregate: reuse it, do not re-create it as optional provenance. A third definition of 'these artifacts belong together' would be the VisibleAncestorChain problem again.

m1: fold both into the design bead. The privacy input is a precondition of the renderer, not a feature of it.
